name: GIA MCP Server
description: Governance Intelligence Architecture (GIA) is a governance-first MCP server that provides approval gates, auditable decision logs, compliance mapping, and operational safety controls for Claude agents. It connects Claude Desktop and Claude Code to a hosted governance control plane for secure, production-grade AI workflows.
